notes.title: GAME RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear friends!
Here is our game Russian Village Simulator 2 in release!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3714790

We tried to fulfill the requests of all players of the first part of the game. The project was done for a year. Further development is possible only with the active participation of players!

notes.title: GAME RELEASE ON MAY 27TH!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear friends!
Our game has passed all Steam checks and was approved for release, which will take place on May 27, 2025 at approximately 14:00 Moscow time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3714790

All interested bloggers can contact us about the key at vdgamesstudio@gmail.com. Keys will be issued 3 days before the release.
